name: clodcast
description: Two podcast skills on one production stack — daily-podcast turns saved URLs into a fully-produced daily-digest Spotify episode, and frontier-commits ships a weekly episode watching the frontier AI labs' public GitHub activity, both using Qwen3-TTS on top of the save-to-spotify CLI.

plugins.name: clodcast
plugins.description: Two podcast skills. `daily-podcast` is the daily digest: manifest → mp3 → cover → Spotify upload → timeline with chapters and per-segment link companions. `frontier-commits` is the weekly lab watch: frontier AI labs' public GitHub activity (new repos, releases, archivals, star trends) into a speculation-forward episode through the same renderer.
